stage_f_failure.error: RuntimeError: Expected all tensors to be on the same device, but found at least two devices, cuda:0 and cpu!
stage_f_failure.diagnosis: the treatment operator attention.activation_importance_v1 multiplies activation statistics against s_attn.o_proj.weight without placing both on one device. The persistent StatsCache lives on the host by design (autoinit/device.py: 'the persistent cache stays on the host; this is the per-invocation working copy'), while the model weights are on cuda:0. The operator does not call stats_to() for this product.
stage_f_failure.why_no_earlier_run_caught_it: attention.activation_importance_v1 is the C1 TREATMENT operator. It had never executed on a GPU: every $0 regression runs it on CPU, where host stats and host weights are trivially co-located, and no prior attempt reached stage F at all.
what_it_is_not: not a replay mismatch: both frozen digests MATCHED before this, and no digest comparison failed
not an efficacy observation: no probe was trained or evaluated
not the verified-suffix contract failing: the suffix premise verified, the parent loaded on cuda, and execution began at original step index 3 as designed
